ck.config,state=state)self.ui(self.btn_unlock.config,state=state)deflog(self,message):timestamp=datetime.now().strftime("%H:%M:%S")def_write():self.log_area.config(state="normal")self.log_area.insert(tk.END,f"[{timestamp}]{message}\n")self.log_area.see(tk.END)self.log_area.config(state="disabled")self.ui(_write)#----------UI----------defsetup_ui(self):header_frame=tk.Frame(self.root,bg="#181825",pady=15)header_frame.pack(fill="x")tk.Label(header_frame,text="🎮RobloxServerControlCenter",font=("SegoeUI",15,"bold"),fg="#cdd6f4",bg="#181825",).pack()self.status_card=tk.Frame(self.root,bg="#313244",pady=15,padx=20)self.status_card.pack(fill="x",padx=20,pady=12)tk.Label(self.status_card,text="สถานะเซิร์ฟเวอร์ปัจจุบัน:",font=("SegoeUI",10),fg="#a6adc8",bg="#313244",).pack(anchor="w")self.status_lbl=tk.Label(self.status_card,text="⏳กำลังตรวจสอบสถานะ...",font=("SegoeUI",13,"bold"),fg="#f9e2af",bg="#313244",pady=6,)self.status_lbl.pack(anchor="w")self.last_check_lbl=tk.Label(self.status_card,text="ตรวจสอบล่าสุด:-",font=("SegoeUI",9),fg="#585b70",bg="#313244",)self.last_check_lbl.pack(anchor="w")control_frame=tk.LabelFrame(self.root,text="แผงควบคุมระบบ",font=("SegoeUI",10,"bold"),fg="#cdd6f4",bg="#1e1e2e",bd=1,relief="solid",padx=15,pady=12,)control_frame.pack(fill="x",padx=20,pady=5)tk.Label(control_frame,text="APIKey(วางแล้วกดบันทึก):",font=("SegoeUI",9),fg="#cdd6f4",bg="#1e1e2e",).pack(anchor="w",pady=(0,3))key_row=tk.Frame(control_frame,bg="#1e1e2e")key_row.pack(fill="x",pady=(0,10))tk.Button(key_row,text="💾บันทึก",font=("SegoeUI",9,"bold"),bg="#89b4fa",fg="#11111b",bd=0,cursor="hand2",command=self.save_key,).pack(side="right",padx=(6,0),ipady=3,ipadx=6)tk.Button(key_row,text="📋วางคีย์",font=("SegoeUI",9,"bold"),bg="#f9e2af",fg="#11111b",bd=0,cursor="hand2",command=self.paste_key,).pack(side="right",padx=(6,0),ipady=3,ipadx=6)self.key_entry=tk.Entry(key_row,font=("SegoeUI",10),bg="#313244",fg="#cdd6f4",insertbackground="white",bd=0,show="•",width=10,)self.key_entry.insert(0
